name: Swale and drain (privacy screen on the berm)
notes: Group plan: swale on contour between house and cabin to hold water coming down the slope and divert it from the boggy patch at the driveway; water-tolerant plants on its edge, a privacy screen under about 2 m on the berm. Needs deeper observation first. (Position indicative: traced from the group's drone photo and sketches onto the 2019 aerial; check on site.)
